# Change request checklist

Copy this checklist for each change. Mark any item that does not apply as N/A.

**Change title**

## Feedback and desired outcome

- [ ] Describe the feedback or problem.
- [ ] Identify who is affected and when they encounter the problem.
- [ ] Describe what should happen after the change.

**Feedback or problem**

**Affected user and situation**

**Desired outcome**

## Decisions and scope

- [ ] Record agreed decisions and open questions.
- [ ] Identify the relevant module specification and what needs to change in it.
- [ ] Describe any changes to screens or interactions, backend or API behavior, data, and permissions.

**Agreed decisions**

**Open questions**

**Module specification and proposed update**

**UI changes**

**Backend, API, or data behavior**

**Permissions and who can do what**

## Acceptance checks

- [ ] Write checks that someone can observe and verify.

| Action or scenario | Expected result |
| --- | --- |
| | |

## Review and implementation handoff

- [ ] Review the proposed change and resolve any questions that block implementation.
- [ ] Record approval before implementation begins.
- [ ] Update the module specification with the agreed changes.
- [ ] Hand off the approved scope, specification, and acceptance checks to the implementation owner.

**Reviewer and approval date**

**Implementation owner and handoff reference**

## Verification and outcome

- [ ] Run the acceptance checks and record the results.
- [ ] Record the final outcome and any follow-up.

**Verification results**

**Final outcome**

**Follow-up and owner**
